summary: Iter223 Unified AssistantKernel: 17/17 backend tests PASS (stats/tools/chat/direct-tool/session/alerts/firewall regression). Frontend has 2 CRITICAL UI bugs: (1) FAB unclickable due to z-index overlap by floating-sidebar-hide-button (z-70 over FAB's z-40 at same bottom-left position), (2) message state wiped immediately after send due to race condition in AssistantProvider (session-reload useEffect overwrites optimistic state with empty server response when chat creates a new session_id).

ui_bugs.issue: FAB (data-testid='unified-assistant-fab', z-40, bottom-6 left-6) is COMPLETELY OVERLAPPED on desktop by floating-sidebar-visibility-wrapper (z-[70], lg:bottom-6 lg:left-6). Click events go to the eye/sidebar-toggle button instead of FAB. Confirmed via document.elementsFromPoint() — top element at FAB center is the sidebar toggle SVG, not the FAB. Only JS .click() bypasses; real users CANNOT open the assistant via mouse click.

Even without the toggle overlap, FAB at left-6 bottom-6 sits BEHIND the dark sidebar panel on desktop (sidebar occupies ~325px on the left). Move FAB to bottom-right OR offset it past the sidebar width, OR raise its z-index above the sidebar.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking send/suggestion, user msg appears (msgs=1) for ~1s then DISAPPEARS (msgs=0). Root cause in /app/frontend/src/components/assistant/AssistantProvider.jsx: sendMessage (line 120) calls setSessionId(data.session_id) for new sessions; this triggers the useEffect at lines 45-65 which does GET /assistant/session/{id} and unconditionally calls setMessages(msgs) — overwriting the optimistic local state. Race: the GET fires before/around the time setMessages(prev=>[...prev, assistantMsg]) at line 129 runs, and msgs may be empty if backend hasn't persisted yet. Fix options: (a) skip the reload-on-sessionId-change effect when sessionId was set inside sendMessage, (b) only reload session messages on MOUNT (initial sessionId from localStorage), (c) merge instead of replace.

issues: FAB hidden behind left sidebar — invisible UX
When toggle eye button (sidebar-hide) overlaps FAB, both icons sit literally on top of each other at 1920x1080 — visual confusion + click conflict

action_items: FIX FAB z-index / position: raise unified-assistant-fab to z-[80] OR move to bottom-right OR place inside floating-sidebar-visibility-wrapper as a sibling so it's not occluded.

FIX AssistantProvider race: prevent session-reload useEffect (lines 45-65) from overwriting messages when sessionId was just produced by sendMessage. Suggest a useRef flag (e.g., justCreatedRef) or only fetch when sessionId came from localStorage on initial mount.
After fixing the two issues above, re-run frontend Playwright to validate full chat round-trip (user msg + assistant reply + tool_results badge).
critical_code_review_comments: AssistantProvider.jsx line 45-65: setMessages(msgs) inside useEffect that fires on every sessionId change is dangerous — will overwrite local optimistic state. Add guard or de-duplicate.

Layout.jsx line 260: floating-sidebar-visibility-wrapper uses z-[70] but UnifiedAssistantDrawer FAB uses z-40 — z-index hierarchy inconsistent; document/standardize floating button stacking layers (sidebar=70, FAB should be ≥70 or live outside this column).

Backend /api/firewall/dashboard returns wrapped {success, data:{health, alerts}} — but problem statement claimed top-level health/alerts. Spec mismatch; update either docs or backend response shape so frontend integrations remain consistent.

success_rate.frontend: 40% (FAB/Drawer DOM renders; click + message persistence broken)

seed_data_creation: None. Used workshop_id=finmodule-sync. ar_summary returned 2 debtors / total_ar=3569 SAR as expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Assistant Kernel is solid (17 pytest pass: stats=5 tools, ai_enabled=true; chat routes correctly to FirewallAgent/FinanceAgent; direct tool call returns persisted ar_summary; alert_bus auto-populated after firewall dashboard call). FRONTEND has 2 blocking bugs documented above — re-test after main agent fixes FAB z-index and AssistantProvider session-reload race. Use page.evaluate(...).click() as a workaround for FAB during interim testing.

fab_unclickable.reproduction: Open / on desktop (1920x1080), wait for dashboard, attempt to click bottom-left assistant icon
fab_unclickable.root_cause: Layout.jsx wraps floating-sidebar toggle in z-[70] container at lg:bottom-6 lg:left-6 — exact same coords as FAB which only has z-40. document.elementsFromPoint at FAB center returns sidebar-toggle SVG on top.
fab_unclickable.mitigation: Change FAB className 'z-40' → 'z-[80]' OR translate FAB to bottom-right, OR conditionally hide sidebar-toggle when desktop sidebar is already visible.

messages_disappear.reproduction: Open drawer via JS, click any suggestion, observe msgs count over 20s: spikes to 1 then drops to 0
messages_disappear.root_cause: sendMessage in AssistantProvider sets new session_id (line 120) → triggers useEffect at line 45 → GET /assistant/session/{id} → setMessages(msgs) overwrites optimistic state; backend may not have written messages yet, so msgs=[].
messages_disappear.mitigation: Add a ref flag `skipNextSessionReload.current = true` before setSessionId in sendMessage, and check it in the useEffect; OR only run the session-reload effect when sessionId comes from localStorage (initial mount), not from sendMessage.
